description: Labelled proposal/candidate pairs for the V2 judge (plan 25 §5.8, §11). class is the relation of the proposal to the candidate. stage0 is what the no-model stage must find (exact, near) or empty. trap marks the pairs that differ only in a number, date, qualifier or negation, and reversals of a decision. explicit marks proposals that say the decision changed.
